City of Encinitas
Special City Council Meeting 6:00 p.m. (Supplemental Info added 12-3-2024 12:20 p.m.)
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 4, 2024 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL : Council Member Ehlers will be participating via teleconference from 840 Audubon Way #SV15, Lincolnshire, IL 60069
AGENDA ITEM
1.
Public hearing to consider a revision to a previously approved density bonus, condominium subdivision, design review permit, and coastal development permit, including a reduction of the number of units from 149 to 134 townhome units (120 market rate and 14 affordable units), an increase in open space conservation easement area, and changes to retaining wall heights (MULTI-007530-2024, SUB-007538-2024, DR-007537-2024, CDP-007539-2024; APNs: 254-144-01-00 & 216-110-35-00). ENVIRONMENTAL CONSIDERATIONS: Prior project approvals included certification of the Piraeus Point Final Environmental Impact Report (SCH #2022050516), adoption of findings of facts, and approvals of a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program and Statement of Overriding Considerations pursuant to City Council Resolution 2023-72. Pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, an Addendum (Attachment CC-2) to the previously certified Environmental Impact Report (Attachment CC-3) was prepared in accordance with CEQA Guidelines Section 15164 as there were minor changes proposed that do not result in significant new environmental effects. None of the conditions identified in CEQA Guidelines Section 15162 requiring the preparation of a subsequent EIR have occurred. Contact Person: Senior Planner Danna
Adopt attached draft City Council Resolution No. 2024-133 titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, to Approve Revisions to a Previously Approved Density Bonus, Condominium Subdivision, Design Review Permit, and Coastal Development Permit, Including a Reduction of the Number of Units from 149 to 134 Townhome Units (120 Market Rate and 14 Affordable Units), an Increase in Open Space Conservation Easement Area, and Changes to Retaining Wall Heights, and Adopt an Addendum to the Previously Certified Environmental Impact Report (CASE NOS. MULTI-007530-2024, SUB-007538-2024, DR-007537-2024, CDP-007539-2024; APNs: 254-144-01-00 & 216-110-35-00)" to approve, with conditions, the revised density bonus, condominium subdivision, design review permit, and coastal development permit requests and approve an addendum to previously certified Environmental Impact Report.

2.
Consider granting easement on Piraeus Street and Plato Place to Lennar Homes of California, LLC ("Lennar") to allow construction of required private development improvements if the project (MULTI-007530-2024, SUB-007538-2024, DR-007537-2024, CDP-007539-2024; APNs: 254-144-01-00 & 216-110-35-00) is approved by the City Council. Environmental Considerations: The request is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15378(b)(5) of the CEQA Guidelines, as an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in a direct or indirect physical change in the environment." Project improvements within the proposed easement area were included with prior project approvals including certification of the Piraeus Point Final Environmental Impact Report (SCH #2022050516), adoption of findings of facts, and approvals of a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program and Statement of Overriding Considerations and Addendum to the EIR pursuant to City Council Resolution No. CC-2023-72 and Resolution No. CC-2024-133, respectively. Contact Person: Director of Administrative Services and Human Resources Schwarm and Special Counsel Noya
1) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2024-136 titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Approving the Granting of an Easement on City-Owned Lands on Piraeus Street and Plato Place Adjacent to APNS 254-144-01 & 216-110-35 to Lennar Homes of California, LLC" to approve and authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute "Grant of Easement and Agreement", in substantial form, in consultation with the City Attorney, subject to the terms and conditions therein including monetary consideration to be paid to City in the amount of One Million, Eight Hundred Thousand Dollars ($1,800,000). This action is contingent on City Council prior approval of the Lennar project; and 2) Receive and adopt report on General Plan conformity pursuant to Government Code Section 65402.

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
